config.label: Hetzner Cloud API token from the Cloud Console (project > Security > API tokens)
config.description: Hetzner Cloud API token from the Cloud Console (project > Security > API tokens). The server can do exactly what this token allows; use a Read token if the client only needs to read.

config.label: true: every tool that is not read-only, and hcloud_raw_request with a method other than GET, returns an error without sending a request
config.description: true: every tool that is not read-only, and hcloud_raw_request with a method other than GET, returns an error without sending a request. Any value other than true, 1, yes, false, 0, no or empty stops the server at startup.

config.label: true: every tool that is not read-only returns a preview unless the call carries confirm "YES"
config.description: true: every tool that is not read-only returns a preview unless the call carries confirm "YES". Friction against mistakes, not a security boundary.

config.label: Comma-separated tool name globs (for example hcloud_delete_*,hcloud_raw_request) that always return an error
config.description: Comma-separated tool name globs (for example hcloud_delete_*,hcloud_raw_request) that always return an error. Deny hcloud_raw_request as well, otherwise denied endpoints stay reachable through it. A pattern that matches no tool stops the server at startup.

config.label: Log level of the JSON logs on stderr
config.description: Log level of the JSON logs on stderr.
